headline: Get ahead of the property game
transcript_text: If you're choosing between new launch or resale this year, you might be asking the wrong question. Everyone's debating, should I buy resale because it's cheaper? Or should I buy a new launch because it's future-proof? But here's what most people miss. It's not about price at this point of time, but it's about positioning. Last year, the price gap between a resale and a new launch was huge. But this year, the gap has narrowed significantly. So now the real question is, are you paying a premium for potential? Or are you buying a value that has already been matured? More importantly, how does this purchase affect your next move? Because a wrong entry point today can delay your upgrade by 3-5 years. Before you commit to either option, sit down with me and we'll map out your 5-year plan. Message me plan and I'll walk you through it.
